name: Aurora Gradient Hero
implementation: Layered radial gradients + blur + slow keyframes + subtle noise
uxGoal: Brand recall and modern premium atmosphere above the fold
performanceNotes: Use CSS instead of heavy canvas by default; reduce blur layers on mobile
a11yNotes: Respect prefers-reduced-motion and keep text contrast >= WCAG AA

name: Scroll-Depth Reveal
implementation: Sticky cards with progressive scale/offset
uxGoal: Guide users through a step sequence with visual hierarchy
performanceNotes: Prefer transform/opacity only; avoid layout-thrashing properties
a11yNotes: Do not block content behind mandatory motion; preserve reading order

name: Cursor Spotlight Cards
implementation: Per-card CSS variable update for radial highlight center
uxGoal: Increase perceived polish and interaction clarity
performanceNotes: Track pointer only on hovered elements; avoid global mouse listeners
a11yNotes: Effect must be decorative only; content remains fully readable

name: Magnetic CTA
implementation: Translate CTA slightly toward cursor with spring-like reset
uxGoal: Boost CTA salience without aggressive animation
performanceNotes: Keep translation small; disable on touch-only devices if needed
a11yNotes: Keyboard focus style and click target size must remain stable

name: Masked Text Reveal
implementation: Overlay mask translated away when entering viewport
uxGoal: Sequence key claims for stronger message retention
performanceNotes: Use IntersectionObserver; avoid scroll polling
a11yNotes: Ensure text exists in DOM and is not image-based

name: Floating Glass UI
implementation: Low-amplitude translateY loop with translucent cards
uxGoal: Convey live system feeling and premium interface quality
performanceNotes: Low amplitude and low frequency animations reduce distraction
a11yNotes: Stop motion under prefers-reduced-motion

name: SVG Path Journey
implementation: SVG path with stroke-dasharray/stroke-dashoffset and a moving marker
uxGoal: Visualize progression from attention to conversion in one focused motion
performanceNotes: Animate stroke and transforms only; throttle updates with requestAnimationFrame
a11yNotes: Keep copy readable without animation and complete state under prefers-reduced-motion

name: Mobile Bottom Sheet Snap
implementation: Pointer events with drag handle and two snap states (mid/open)
uxGoal: Expose details and CTA without leaving current context on small screens
performanceNotes: Animate transform only and avoid continuous layout work during drag
a11yNotes: Provide tap fallback, stable focus order, and reduced-motion safe default

name: Tilt Cards 3D
implementation: Card transform with rotateX/rotateY from pointer position
uxGoal: Add depth and premium interaction feedback on feature cards
performanceNotes: Use transform only and reset on pointerleave
a11yNotes: Decorative only, keep content readable and stable without pointer

name: Scroll Snap Story Panels
implementation: Y-axis scroll-snap panels with mild panel offset for depth
uxGoal: Guide users through short sequential claims with clear focus
performanceNotes: Use native scroll-snap and lightweight transform offsets
a11yNotes: Ensure keyboard scroll and readable static state

name: Canvas Particle Drift
implementation: 2D canvas particles with depth factor and pointer-influenced drift
uxGoal: Create premium dynamic atmosphere in hero background
performanceNotes: Cap DPR, keep particle count controlled, reduce motion amplitude
a11yNotes: Avoid critical information in moving layer and respect reduced motion

name: View Transition Routing
implementation: Use startViewTransition API with fade fallback
uxGoal: Preserve context and continuity during view switches
performanceNotes: Keep transitions short and avoid heavy layout changes during swap
a11yNotes: Must remain usable with no API support and reduced motion preferences

name: Shimmer Hover
implementation: Pseudo-element gradient sweep in CSS
uxGoal: Premium micro-feedback without JS
performanceNotes: CSS only, short duration
a11yNotes: Decorative effect only

name: 3D Tilt Glass Shine
implementation: Tilted card with moving shine hotspot and glass layers
uxGoal: Create high-end card depth and motion polish
performanceNotes: Use transform and CSS variables; cap rotation range
a11yNotes: Keep keyboard focus style and readable static content

name: Scroll Reveal Stagger
implementation: IntersectionObserver with staggered delay values
uxGoal: Improve content scan rhythm and narrative pacing
performanceNotes: Observer-based and low-cost transitions
a11yNotes: Respect reduced motion and preserve reading order

name: SVG Self-Drawing Path
implementation: stroke-dasharray and stroke-dashoffset line animation with staged fill
uxGoal: Create cinematic hero entry and brand recall
performanceNotes: Short one-time animation; avoid long loops
a11yNotes: Provide complete static state for reduced motion

name: Gradient Border Grain
implementation: Conic-gradient animated border with noise overlay and hover light response
uxGoal: Increase perceived quality of highlighted cards
performanceNotes: Prefer CSS gradients over heavy assets
a11yNotes: Decorative layer only, maintain text contrast

name: Clip-Path Hover Reveal
implementation: clip-path circle reveal following pointer position
uxGoal: Interactive preview reveal for case studies and portfolio cards
performanceNotes: GPU-friendly clip-path usage on a single element
a11yNotes: Ensure content remains accessible without hover

name: Infinite Logo Marquee
implementation: Duplicated track with linear translateX loop and edge masking
uxGoal: Show social proof/integrations with gentle motion
performanceNotes: Pause on hover and keep speed moderate
a11yNotes: Stop or reduce movement when reduced motion is set

name: Toggle Morph Microinteraction
implementation: Toggle with morphing icon and squash-stretch transitions
uxGoal: Add delightful feedback for settings/actions
performanceNotes: Short transitions and no layout reflow
a11yNotes: Use aria-pressed and clear on/off state labels
